summary: Shopify Inc. filed an 8-K to announce that its Notice of 2026 Annual General Meeting and Management Information Circular has been filed with Canadian securities authorities and is attached as an exhibit. This is a routine annual meeting notice and proxy statement for a foreign private issuer, containing proposals to receive financial statements, elect directors, and reappoint auditors. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change—is described. The filing is purely procedural and informational.
